what.description: Core fact - concise but complete (1-2 sentences)
what.title: What

who.description: People involved with relationships. 'N/A' if general.
who.title: Who

fact_type.description: 'world' = objective/external facts, including user preferences, rules, corrections, and constraints even when stated during a conversation. 'assistant' = actions, experiences, or observations the assistant/agent actually performed.
fact_type.title: Fact Type

entities.description: People, places, concepts - plain strings, e.g. ["Alice", "Kubernetes"]
entities.title: Entities

causal_relations.description: Links to previous facts (target_index < this fact's index)
causal_relations.title: Causal Relations

FactCausalRelation.description:
Causal relationship from this fact to a PREVIOUS fact (embedded in each fact).

Uses index-based references but ONLY allows referencing facts that appear
BEFORE this fact in the list. This prevents hallucination of invalid indices.

target_index.description: Index of the PREVIOUS fact this relates to (0-based). MUST be less than this fact's position in the list. Example: if this is fact #5, target_index can only be 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4.
target_index.title: Target Index

relation_type.description: How this fact relates to the target fact: 'caused_by' = this fact was caused by the target fact
relation_type.title: Relation Type

FactCausalRelation.title: FactCausalRelation

description: Response containing all extracted facts (causal relations are embedded in each fact).
title: FactExtractionResponse
